name: Monomodule One (Gen2)
author: sd88me
summary: The Elektron Monomachine's synth engine (15 machines) as an instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin, banks and preset lists, and Q-Links. A ready-made download: nothing of Elektron's is in the zip; you put your own Monomachine OS file in the plugin folder and it makes its skin and sound from that. Gen2 (aarch64) only.
